notes.title: The game is out!
notes.content:
We are happy to inform you that the game is finally out and now everyone can play it.We invite you to dive into this unforgettable adventure with us!

notes.title: Release on June 20!
notes.content:
June 20, 2025 ːsteamthumbsupːAfter a long wait, we want to inform you that the game is already completely ready and will be released on the appointed day!


There's just a little bit of patience left and everyone will be able to master the art of Pogo and compete with other players in the title of the most skilled master.
